full_track.tags: K-Pop rock anthem featuring distorted electric guitars, driving acoustic drums, and a slap bass technique. The arrangement utilizes a bright, polished production style typical of modern Korean pop-rock. Male and female vocalists perform in a call-and-response and unison format, characterized by powerful chest-voice delivery and occasional vibrato. The tempo is 128 BPM in the key of E Major. Electric guitars execute palm-muted power chords in the verses and open, ringing chords in the choruses. The drum kit features a crisp snare and active hi-hat patterns with frequent crash cymbal accents on phrase transitions.
